headlines.title: G7 to release millions of barrels of oil and diesel after Trump threat
headlines.summary: The co-ordinated release is aimed at heading off further price spikes and avoiding a ban on US diesel exports.

headlines.title: Schools closed, services slowed and flights cancelled: strikes hit Portugal
headlines.summary: Three CGTP unions have called a strike for Friday, disrupting schools, public services, councils and rubbish collection. An easyJet cabin crew walkout is also causing flight delays nationwide.

headlines.summary: News, Analysis and Service from Germany and Europe - in 30 Languages

headlines.title: Two Iranians charged with alleged bomb plot against Britain s Jewish community
headlines.summary: Police said the two men received instructions and materials to make a homemade bomb for possible use on Jewish targets.

headlines.title: Suppliers pile pressure on government over energy bills
headlines.summary: Immediate action is needed to help households struggling with bills this winter, says trade body Energy UK.

headlines.title: Trans-Caspian Corridor: Europe and Central Asia target faster trade
headlines.summary: Transit along the Trans-Caspian Corridor currently takes around 35 days, with a target of cutting this to between 15 and 20. Officials say customs, digital systems and predictable border procedures are as important as new railways and ports.

headlines.title: Weakened US fuel-efficiency rules and promises of cheaper cars could see drivers pay higher running costs while also increasing carbon emissions.
headlines.summary: Weakened US fuel-efficiency rules and promises of cheaper cars could yet see drivers pay higher running costs while increasing planet-heating emissions.

headlines.title: Spaniards protest housing crisis as Sánchez weighs snap vote
headlines.summary: With a potential early election looming, the demonstrations highlight growing frustration with the country's political establishment.

headlines.title: UK diesel prices top £2 a litre for first time, RAC says
headlines.summary: The rise in global oil prices has been pushing up the pump prices of petrol and diesel in the UK.

headlines.title: Where in Europe is data centre hiring growing fastest – and why do these jobs pay more?
headlines.summary: Several European countries have seen a significant rise in data centre job postings in recent months. Euronews Business takes a closer look at the reasons behind the growth, including why these roles offer higher pay.

headlines.title: Is US President Donald Trump right to rename AI as Super Intelligence ?
headlines.summary: Donald Trump thinks the name artificial intelligence sounds fake and has ordered US agencies to use Super Intelligence instead. Yet, tech firms and researchers have little reason to play along.

headlines.title: Sandu slams Russia as attack debris hits Moldova in latest airspace violation
headlines.summary: Three missile and two drones entered Moldovan airspace and caused collateral damage in the country, local authorities said.

headlines.title: US jobs market sees sharp slowdown ahead of midterm elections
headlines.summary: Unemployment rose slightly as American employers paused hiring with midterm elections just a month away.

headlines.title: José Sevilla resigns as Unicaja chair and declines to remain at the bank
headlines.summary: José Sevilla will step down as Unicaja chairman in April 2027 after deciding not to seek a new term, but will retain his non-executive role at the Málaga-based bank until then.

headlines.title: Russia hits major Kyiv bridge, logistics hub in latest attack
headlines.summary: Russia struck a key bridge in Kyiv connecting the left and right bank of the Dnipro river overnight Saturday, as Moscow steps up its aerial campaign against Ukraine. headlines.title: 'It could cost me £10k but I need the money now': Why Gen Z are opting out of pensions
headlines.summary: A growing number of people are opting out of these schemes due to cost-of-living pressures.

headlines.title: EU watchdogs question Binance over unlicensed European operations
headlines.summary: European regulators are questioning Binance over its use of a narrow legal exemption to keep serving EU customers without a licence, the Financial Times reported. Binance told Euronews it is working towards authorisation, while ESMA said enforcement is a matter for national authorities.

headlines.title: Widdecombe murder suspect charged with planning terror act on Nigel Farage
headlines.summary: Joshua Kerry was previously accused of murdering former lawmaker and Reform spokesperson Anne Widdecombe.

headlines.title: The wealthy Cuban Americans ready and waiting for Havana to fall
headlines.summary: Cuban exiles in Florida are increasingly hopeful that regime change in Cuba is now on the horizon.

headlines.title: Portugal records biggest EU rise in house prices in second quarter
headlines.summary: Eurostat data shows Portugal recorded the EU's sharpest rise in house prices in Q2 2026 versus a year earlier. In September, national housing costs hit a fresh record high.
